summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  ### What I found from reading the code (no changes made)  I read the full chain: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `modules/watchlist/schema.ts` → session handling in `db/auth.ts` / `modules/auth/handlers.ts` → mounting in `server.ts`.  On paper, the wiring is correct: - `watchlists.user_id` is NOT NULL — every list is owned by a real user, no shared/default list exists. - `watchlistRouter.use("*", ...)` requires a valid session cookie or bearer token on **every** watchlist rout
